```{r}
n <- 10
x <- (1:n)/2
beta_true <- c(10, 3, 2)
sigma_true <- 1/2

g <- function(x, beta) beta[1]*x/(beta[2]+x) + beta[3]

y <- g(x, beta_true) + rnorm(n, 0, sigma_true)

grad_g <- function(x, beta) {
  cbind(
    x/(beta[2]+x),
    -beta[1]*x/(beta[2]+x)^2,
    rep(1, length(x))
  )
}

levmar_linear <- function(x, y, beta0, lambda0=1e-3, v=10, 
                          tol=1e-4, max_iter=1000) {
  n <- length(y)
  p <- length(beta0)
  beta <- beta0
  lambda <- lambda0

  
  S <- function(b) sum((y - g(x, beta))^2)
  for (s in 1:max_iter) {
    
  G <- grad_g(x, beta)
    
  r <- y - g(x, beta)
  A <- t(G) %*% G + lambda * diag(p)
  beta_new <- beta + solve(A, t(G) %*% r)
    
  if (sqrt(sum((beta_new - beta)^2)) <= tol) {
      beta <- beta_new
      break
    }
    
    if(S(beta_new) < S(beta)){
      beta <- beta_new
      lambda <- lambda / v
    }
    else{
      lambda <- lambda * v
    }
  }
  return(beta)
}
levmar_linear(x, y, c(8, 2, 1))
```
